script_text: Stop scrolling! Gemini, the cosmos is humming with energy this week. Monday (Feb 12) brings Mercury trine Jupiter, perfect for expanding ideas and sealing deals—write that proposal now. Embrace the rhythm, stay flexible, and let your authentic voice shine brightly.
